title: VeriCEMS Telemetry Batch
description: A contiguous batch of signed telemetry packets summarized by an on-chain Merkle root.

device_id.description: Unique identifier of the registered edge gateway device.

first_seq.description: Sequence number of the first packet in the batch.

last_seq.description: Sequence number of the last packet in the batch (must equal first_seq + count - 1 for gapless batches).

count.description: Total number of packets included as leaves in this batch.

merkle_root.description: 0x-prefixed lowercase 32-byte hex keccak256 Merkle root of the batch leaves.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the batch was sealed (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ).
